tara_cs: Ping — new customer 'Maple' reporting onboarding flakiness: auth errors + 429s during Node SDK warmup. They reported ~210 concurrent session opens.

ingrid_prod: Logs (snip):
```
[2026-07-01T16:04:12Z] session=ui-01 auth=ok token_age=2s status=200
[2026-07-01T16:04:12Z] session=ui-02 auth=failed error=insufficient_quota
[2026-07-01T16:04:12Z] session=ui-03 status=429 message=\"rate limit exceeded\"
```
Init:
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.preflight(); // called on every tab/session open
```

tara_cs: Sounds like a preflight stampede. Nolan, can you advise a minimal patch we can hand to the customer?

nolan_eng: Yep. Short checklist: 1) stop preflight-per-tab, 2) cache preflight in-process for 30-60s, 3) add random splay before preflight when ramping, 4) use one ephemeral token per session instead of per-request, 5) enable http2 keepalive/connection pooling.

nolan_eng: Minimal code snippet (drop-in):
```
// process-level cached preflight + jitter
let _pf = {ts:0, res:null};
async function cachedPreflight(){
  if(Date.now()-_pf.ts < 45000) return _pf.res; // 45s cache
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.floor(Math.random()*300)+50));
  _pf = {ts: Date.now(), res: await client.preflight()};
  return _pf.res;
}
```

infra-bot: Alert: key=rw_live_xxxx observed onboarding-throttle at 2026-07-01T16:04:12Z. Window=120s peak_rps=59 avg_rps=13. Recommend lower parallel preflight to <=20 or request a short warmup quota bump.

ingrid_prod: Implemented the patch: 45s cache, 50-350ms splay, reduced warmup concurrency to 18. Quick canary shows 429s fell from ~32% of sessions to ~1.5%.

tara_cs: Great. Two operational next steps: (1) file support ticket if they need a temporary ramp above 20 and include canary timestamps; (2) capture their token_age and source ip in preflight logs for us to correlate if we need to lift throttles.

nolan_eng: If they anticipate sustained >50 rps we should discuss Dedicated/reserved warmup. For short spikes, CS can request a 10-minute quota increase via support.

ingrid_prod: Filing ticket now and will paste the id. Thanks all :raised_hands:
